title: Data and Utilities
summary: This module encompasses datasets, data loading, streaming capabilities, asynchronous execution, and general utility functions for DSPy programs.

nodes.label: Datasets and Data Loading
nodes.title: Datasets and Data Loading
nodes.description: Provides utilities for loading, processing, and managing various datasets, including specialized datasets like AlfWorld, GSM8K, and MATH, and general data loaders for common formats.

nodes.label: Streaming and Asynchronous Utilities
nodes.title: Streaming and Asynchronous Utilities
nodes.description: Provides utilities for streaming program outputs and managing asynchronous execution within DSPy, enabling real-time feedback and non-blocking operations.

nodes.label: General Utilities
nodes.title: General Utilities
nodes.description: Provides a collection of general-purpose utilities, including text tokenization, configuration management, file downloading, callback wrappers, and dummy models for testing.

nodes.label: Documentation and Hooks
nodes.title: Documentation and Hooks
nodes.description: Manages the generation of API documentation and integrates various hooks to fetch and display live statistics on the website.

groups.label: Data Management
groups.title: Data Management
groups.description: Handles all aspects of data, from loading various datasets to managing their structure and access within DSPy programs.

groups.label: Execution Control
groups.title: Execution Control
groups.description: Manages how DSPy programs execute, offering streaming capabilities and asynchronous processing for enhanced responsiveness and efficiency.

groups.label: Core Utilities
groups.title: Core Utilities
groups.description: A collection of fundamental helper functions and tools that support various operations across the DSPy framework, including configuration and text processing.

groups.label: System Support
groups.title: System Support
groups.description: Provides infrastructure for documentation generation and integrates system-level hooks for fetching external data and managing website content.
